items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: I managed Joe. And, see, and he worked in the show. And I managed him for five years.

ctx.x: This was when Joe was playing -- he was a great player, he would play -- he was with Tweet Ogen's band. I don't know whether you remember it. But, anyway, they came back -- so he come down on 18th Street, and so they finally -- they sent all over town to get Lester, see, because Ben and he had been tying up there, so Ben went over to the piano, see, playing chords, and Lester and --
